title: 第3章 神之恩赐第4章 苏醒第5章 全知之眼
content_zh:
沐云还不清楚，他接下来可能要面对的挑战。在洗完澡之后，他将工具一一收拾好，接着就把手办放到楼下的收藏柜里面，东西都归到定位之后就准备要去休息了。
可能是因为刘宜国的话，给了沐云一丝的警觉。他没有上去顶楼的房间，他到了地下室的车库旁，从一个角落缓缓的推开了一道暗门。
暗门里边，是一间大概十来坪左右的房间。有一套卫浴设备，两张桌子和一张床，靠门的墙壁上有着一整排架子，架上满满的都是监控的萤幕。
这个房间是沐云房子的中央防控安管中心，原设计是提供物业保安休息和监控维安的地方。但是因为沐云的病情，他透过文书与物业协商，他的房子只有保安定时巡逻，而没有让保安入驻，因此这个房间便空了下来。
不过，一段时间沐云还是会让物业的人过来。一方面，让他们检查设备是否完善，评估是否有着维安死角。另一方面，顺带让他们将里面进行一番清理。刚好前两天物业的人有来清理过一趟，因此房间里面到是挺干净的。
沐云把备用的枕头棉被拿了进去，顺手将门关好锁上。稍微整理了一下床铺后，沐云便把灯关掉，整个人躺了上去，不一会儿便沉沉睡去。没办法，他已经整整两天没有好好休息了。
不知道睡了多久，沐云有些昏昏沉沉的，总觉得有人拿灯在照他。他一个起身，揉了揉双眼后，就将头往旁边望去。
定眼一看，沐云整个人有些错愕，过了好半响才回过神来。房间里面除了他以外并没有其他人，但是整个房间却是亮的，因为墙壁上的警报灯正闪着红光，照得满室通红。
由于这个房间长期没在使用，因此警报灯的警报铃是处于关闭的状态，也正因如此，这个房间的存在才没有暴露。
看着墙上的监视画面，一大半都已经呈现无讯号的画面，很明显的告诉沐云，这些监视器已经遭到了破坏。看着剩下来还有画面的萤幕，沐云怒瞪着双眼，可是身体却不断的颤抖着。
沐云的生理性重度人群恐惧症，发作了。
剩下来还有画面的监视器，只有几个是屋内的，这几支监视器无一不是安装在较为隐蔽的位置，这个发现让沐云心底一阵发寒，整个病症变得更加的严重了。他感觉到呼吸都有着丝丝的困难，只能缓缓的调适着呼吸，然后用颤抖的手去控制监控设备。
沐云家里的监控设备，有几个是比较高端的，除了360度旋转和红外线夜视功能外，还能撷取音源实施录音。刚好一楼客厅的位置就有一支这样的监视器，重点是还没有被发现。看着监视画面的人影，沐云点选了撷取音源的选项。
由于害怕这个房间被发现，沐云艰难的用颤抖的双手，把耳机与设备对接，然后将耳机戴了上去。看着监视器的画面，听着一道道传入耳中的声音，沐云满脸苍白，却瞪红着双眼，死命的咬紧着牙根...
“人呢？找到没有？”画面中，一个高一米八五，满脸横肉的中年男子，疑似是领头的人，正大声的呼喝着旁边的人。即使沐云是用设被撷取音源，都能听得一清二楚，显然对方是真正的肆无忌惮。
“不知道那家伙躲哪边去了，找都找不到。上边的房间锁着，刚刚才撬开来，可是都搜过了一遍，还是没看到人阿。”
“这么大的人你们都找不倒，你们是吃屎的吗？算了！人没找到，那东西呢？那东西至少值几十万，你们都给我小心一点，要是嗑着碰着了，到时卖不出好价钱，有你们好受的。”
“找到了，找到了，东西找到了！在二楼的一个铁柜里面。只是这柜子锁着墙壁，门也上着锁，打不开阿！”
“门上着锁打不开，你们怎知道东西在里面？”
“他那门上有玻璃，我们是从玻璃照灯进去才发现的。”

“你们是不会把那玻璃敲碎吗？”
“敲过了，可是砸不开。南哥说那玻璃已经差不多是防弹级的了，现在南哥正在想办法把那柜子撬开。”
“娘西皮的，给我搜！我就不信他人能给我消失。净会给我找麻烦，人找到之后把他给我带过来。我到要看看这废物脑子是怎长的，几乎是防弹级别的柜子，呵呵......“中年男子狞笑着。
“对了，所有柜子什么的也都给我翻一翻，看能不能找到柜子的钥匙。”中年男子继续下令道。
“是。”
一声令下，几个小马仔就四散而去，开始翻箱倒柜了起来，沐云在地下室也能听得一清二楚。一股愤怒直冲大脑，沐云恨不得冲上去教他们做人。可是一种无力感却从心中蔓延着，加上发作的病情，直接像桶冰水，浇熄了他那上脑的热血。
过了一段时间后，中年男子坐到了客厅的沙发上，一个身形较为瘦弱的男子，走到了中年男子的旁边。
“刀哥，南哥说东西差不多快能到手了，你这边该准备准备了。”
“还要多久时间？”被称为刀哥的中年男子问道。
content_en:
Mu Yun is still unclear about the challenges he may face next. After taking a shower, he packed up his tools one by one, then put his handicrafts in the storage cabinet downstairs. After everything was in its place, he was ready to take a rest.
Maybe it was because of Liu Yiguo's words that gave Mu Yun a hint of vigilance. He didn't go up to the room on the top floor. He went to the garage in the basement and slowly opened a secret door from a corner.
Inside the secret door is a room of about ten square feet. There is a set of bathroom facilities, two tables and a bed. There is a whole row of shelves on the wall near the door, and the shelves are full of surveillance screens.
This room is the central prevention and control security center of Muyun's house. It was originally designed to provide a place for property security guards to rest and monitor security. However, because of Mu Yun's condition, he negotiated with the property management through paperwork, and only security guards patrolled his house regularly, instead of allowing security guards to move in, so the room became vacant.
However, Mu Yun will still let the property management people come over for a while. On the one hand, let them check whether the equipment is complete and evaluate whether there are security blind spots. On the other hand, let them clean it up by the way. The real estate agent just came to clean it two days ago, so the room was quite clean.
Mu Yun took the spare pillow and quilt in, then closed and locked the door. After making the bed a little, Mu Yun turned off the light, lay down on it, and fell asleep soon. There was nothing he could do, he hadn't had a good rest for two whole days.
He didn't know how long he had slept. Mu Yun felt a little groggy, and he always felt like someone was shining a light on him. He stood up, rubbed his eyes, and looked to the side.
After taking a closer look, Mu Yun was a little stunned. It took him a while to come back to his senses. There was no one else in the room except him, but the whole room was bright because the alarm light on the wall was flashing red, illuminating the whole room.
Since this room has not been used for a long time, the alarm bell of the alarm light is turned off. Because of this, the existence of this room is not exposed.
Looking at the surveillance screens on the wall, most of them showed no signal, which clearly told Mu Yun that these monitors had been destroyed. Looking at the remaining screen, Mu Yun stared angrily, but his body kept shaking.
Mu Yun's severe physiological crowd phobia broke out.
Only a few of the remaining monitors with pictures were inside the house. All of these monitors were installed in relatively hidden locations. This discovery made Mu Yun feel chilly in his heart, and the entire illness became more serious. He felt it was difficult to breathe, so he could only adjust his breathing slowly, and then controlled the monitoring equipment with trembling hands.
Some of the monitoring equipment at Muyun's home are relatively high-end. In addition to 360-degree rotation and infrared night vision functions, they can also capture sound sources for recording. There happens to be such a monitor in the living room on the first floor. The important thing is that it has not been discovered yet. Looking at the figure on the surveillance screen, Mu Yun clicked on the option to capture the sound source.
Fearing that the room would be discovered, Mu Yun struggled to connect the earphones to the device with trembling hands, and then put the earphones on. Looking at the screen on the monitor and listening to the sounds coming into his ears, Mu Yun's face was pale, but his eyes were red, and he clenched his teeth desperately...
"Where is the person? Have you found him?" In the picture, a middle-aged man with a height of 1.85 meters and a sinewy face, who seems to be the leader, is shouting loudly to the people next to him. Even if Mu Yun used a device to capture the sound source, he could hear it clearly. It was obvious that the other party was truly unscrupulous.
"I don't know where the guy is hiding. I can't find him. The room above is locked. I just pried it open, but I searched it again and still didn't see anyone."
"SoYou can't find big people, are you shit eaters? never mind! No one found it, what about that thing? That thing is worth at least hundreds of thousands. You all should be careful. If you touch it while eating it, you won't be able to sell it at a good price, which will make you feel uncomfortable. "
"Found it, found it, found it! Inside an iron cabinet on the second floor. It’s just that the cabinet is locked against the wall and the door is also locked, so it can’t be opened! "
“The door is locked and can’t be opened, how do you know what’s inside? "
“There was glass on his door, and we only discovered it when we entered through the glass light. "
"Aren't you going to break the glass? "
"I've knocked it, but it can't be opened. Brother Nan said that the glass is almost bulletproof, and now Brother Nan is trying to find a way to pry open the cabinet. "
"Mother Xipi, search for me! I don't believe that others can disappear for me. Jing will cause trouble for me. When someone finds him, he will be brought to me. I really want to see how this loser’s brain grows. It’s almost a bulletproof cabinet, haha..." The middle-aged man smiled evilly.
"By the way, go through all the cabinets and stuff for me to see if you can find the keys to the cabinets. "The middle-aged man continued to order.
"Yes. "
After giving the order, the ponyboys scattered and began to rummage through the boxes. Mu Yun could hear it clearly in the basement. A surge of anger rushed straight into his brain, and Mu Yun wanted to rush forward and teach them how to behave. However, a sense of powerlessness spread from his heart, and coupled with the onset of illness, it was like a bucket of ice water, dousing the blood in his upper brain.
After a while, the middle-aged man sat on the sofa in the living room, and a thinner man walked next to the middle-aged man.
"Brother Dao, Brother Nan said that the things are almost available, so you should get ready. "
"How long will it take? asked the middle-aged man known as Brother Dao.
